task.name: direct_sorting
task.instruction: Sort the red cubes into the red tray and the blue cubes into the blue tray.
task.source: external dual-SO101 MuJoCo project, scripted physical expert

state.timing: measured joint state immediately before the action is issued

action.semantics: absolute joint-position target, left six then right six
action.label_rule: clamped actuator target actually applied at that control frame; never the next measured state

collection.attempt_budget_provenance: clean60 measured 60 successes from 175 certified draws (34.3% layout acceptance); 40 successes need ~117 executed layouts, so 400 leaves headroom for expert failures and is a hard stop

measured_expert_wall_clock.source_round: clean60 collection 2026-10-28 (60 episodes, 14,940 s wall incl. layout rejects)
measured_expert_wall_clock.note: the wall limit is a watchdog on this round only; it is not a success criterion

split.rule: 40 independently successful scenes appended after the preserved 60; default first 32 train / last 8 validation in collection order, adjusted only if needed to keep a role-preserving near-duplicate family on one side of the merged 80/20 split

collection.normalisation: computed from the merged 80 train episodes only
collection.success_predicate: external SortingTask.evaluate: tray geometry, support/contact, robot clearance, velocity and sustained stability
collection.failure_policy: every attempt and failure reason is kept; a failed attempt never becomes a demonstration

evaluation.purpose: reserved independent clean-layout scenes; no learned-policy rollout in this round
evaluation.scene_freeze: SceneSpec and SHA-256 written before any policy rollout
evaluation.success_predicate: external SortingTask.evaluate, independent of the policy
evaluation.report: success count / 20 with Wilson 95% interval and failure categories

claims.engineering_chain: 100 clean spread-layout scripted-expert demonstrations (60 preserved + 40 newly collected) -> audited train-only statistics from 80 train episodes
explicitly_not: clean100 training (not started in this round)

scene_layout.minimum_distance_provenance: unchanged from clean60: measured by the wide layout pilot (520 certified sampler draws, public summary reports/so101-clean60-layout-pilot.md); 0.08 m is the registered threshold and is not renegotiated
scene_layout.sampling_region: unchanged certified pick regions and IK certificate; no region widening, no guard relaxation
scene_layout.boundary_margin_m: as certified by the external sampler's own region and clearance checks
scene_layout.method: reject certified direct scenes whose minimum pairwise cube-centre distance is below the registered minimum before any physical execution
scene_layout.reachable: external certified pick regions plus per-scene grasp and hover IK; every admitted episode must complete physical sorting and replay

lineage.merge_rule: old episode indices 0..59 and bytes are preserved unchanged in a new versioned view; new collection episodes 60..99
lineage.family_rule: role-preserving 12.5 mm near-duplicate families are computed over all 100 scenes; a family never crosses train/validation; only the new 32/8 assignment may be adjusted

seed_registry.new_block_provenance: scanned every JSON/JSONL seed under runs/so101 on the pinned host on 2026-10-29: 13000-13999 contained zero seeds; clean60 used 12000-12174 inside its registered 12000-13199 block; clean60 evaluation reserved 14000-14199
seed_registry.pilot_policy: a pilot scene is never reused as a demonstration; the main collection starts at 13200 and every executed seed is recorded
